meta.name: The Sydney Hilton Hotel Conspiracy
meta.description: In 1978, Australia was shocked by the explosion of a massive bomb placed in a rubbish bin outside the Sydney Hilton Hotel in NSW. The perpetrators were never found. However, evidence that the Australian security and intelligence forces may have been responsible resulted in the NSW State Parliament unanimously calling for an inquiry in 1991 and then again in 1995. Both times, the outcomes of hearings resulted in censorship and suppression of evidence. The Federal Government vetoed any inquiry. No investigation was held.
